name: superbee-desktop-preview
description: Open documents and interactive Views in a selected bundle or choose a workspace from your Superbee catalog. Confirm edits before they are written.

workspace.title: Superbee bundle
workspace.description: Choose the local bundle folder containing your Superbee documents.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Enter the identity to record for confirmed edits, for example human:editor.

catalog.title: Use the workspace catalog
catalog.description: Select a workspace per tool call. When enabled, the server uses the catalog and ignores the bundle folder setting.
